title: Agent Long-Term Memory Candidate
description: A single validated long-term memory candidate emitted by the memory extraction model.

action.description: Create a new entry or update a matching existing entry supplied in current_long_term_memories.

memory_id.description: Existing memory ID for update; null for create.

memory_type.description: Information kind: a notable event, a stable fact/preference, or a reusable user-described procedure.

memory_role.description: How the memory guides a response; active constraints take priority over preferences and plans.

scope.description: Whether this memory applies across the user's projects or only within one resolved project.

project_name.description: A known project name or an explicit project name from user evidence; null for global memories. Never output a project ID.

tags.description: Controlled project tags used for coarse filtering.

valid_until.description: Optional expiry time for facts that can become stale.

confidence.description: Model confidence; the project applies its own write threshold.

evidence.description: One or more exact quotes copied from user messages; multiple quotes may jointly support a fact.
